input: Original metre XYZ; the saved production wall, floor and room enclosure are fixed for all methods.

methods.profile: Production profile detector and its fitted four corners
methods.layer_grid: Local implementation of three main height bands, three sub-bands and 20 mm projected bins; metric height-gap classification
methods.layer_xyz: Layered proposals with robust strip-wise fits to original XYZ returns
methods.layer_scalelsd: Identical layered proposals with four lines from the official ScaleLSD v2 checkpoint
methods.profile_xyz: Production window proposals with the same robust XYZ refinement
methods.profile_scalelsd: Production window proposals with the same official ScaleLSD lines, for a matched-proposal comparison
methods.profile_reveal: Additional candidate after the initial pilot. Fit near-face reveal planes on original points and retain a production edge when evidence is insufficient.

truth: M26 has one inventoried window, manual width 2375 mm with unknown tape depth and height 1736 mm. M04 has no inventoried window. No real surveyed corner coordinates.

scoring.association: one-to-one same wall and face-box IoU at least 0.50; real M26 localization uses a frozen production box only as an association proxy
scoring.corner_metric: mean of the four 3D Euclidean errors with fixed A/B/C/D correspondence followed by the median across matched windows
scoring.dimensions: horizontal width at the reference middle height and vertical height at reference horizontal center, with estimates in mm
scoring.depth: shared production step detector. Score signed differences at the documented depth and depth evidence separately from face corners.
scoring.selection: Consider a corroborating method if it matches the real inventory, achieves at least baseline synthetic recall, reduces paired median corner error, and adds no negative-control false positives. A formal default also needs independent real corner and depth truth.
